decisions.why: ndd Easy on-PC, MIR Spirobank II, MIR Spirolab and Resmon Pro FOT are all spirometers/lung function testing devices, matching Diagnostics & spirometry
NIDEK Nuvo Range/Nuvo Lite and INOGEN at Home/ONE G3 are oxygen concentrators, matching Oxygen therapy

A&D TM-2440/TM-2441 and Welch Allyn 7100 ambulatory blood pressure monitors and the Mortara H3+ Holter ECG are specialist patient-worn monitoring devices, matching Specialist monitoring; this is a different speciality (monitoring, not respiratory) from this same supplier's other two mapped divisions, which is a correct expected result
the Bedfont NObreath FeNO Device is an exhaled nitric oxide respiratory diagnostic device, matching Diagnostics & spirometry
